propositions: Plans citing symbols via [rebar:<id>] are flagged missing/unverifiable even when a verified prerequisite ticket will create them, because grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) check only origin/main snapshot and ignore depends_on prerequisites.

Layer-1 advisory det_citation.py must parse [rebar:<id>] tokens and verify each cited id is a direct upstream prerequisite of the plan via both-direction edge check (P.depends_on(C) OR C.blocks(P)), never blocking and always fail-closed.

Layer-2 LLM agent grounding must credit a citation only if Layer-1 verifies the edge AND the reviewer affirmatively confirms via show_ticket that the cited ticket's plan/file_impact establishes the specific missing functionality.
An unverified reverse-lookup (missing ticket, network error, etc.) must be caught and treated as edge-unbacked, never propagating an exception into the advisory lane.
